summary: Iteration 5 (globalization + referrals + push + review highlights) tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest in test_iteration5.py pass — /api/meta returns 12 countries / 27 cities / 10 currencies; /api/events?country=<Name> correctly filters (UAE → only 'Marina Rooftop Sundowner', Japan → only 'Omoide Yokocho Izakaya Trail'); every international city (Dubai/London/Singapore/Bangkok/New York/Sydney/Tokyo/Barcelona) has ≥1 published event with a non-empty cover_image; /api/events?when=past exposes top_review {rating, comment, user_name} for the two finished events (no 'TEST outsider' strings); POST /api/checkout returns correct per-country tax_label + tax_percent for GBP=VAT 20%, AED=VAT 5%, USD=Sales tax 8.875%, JPY=Consumption tax 10%, INR=GST 18%; full referral chain works — GET /api/me/referrals returns code/link/balance/joined/rewarded/reward, POST /api/auth/register with referral_code creates a referral in state 'joined', invitee's first paid booking (POST /api/payments/verify simulate=success) fires award_referral which credits ₹250, next /api/checkout for the inviter auto-applies credit (credit_applied>0, total reduced), sending use_credit:false recreates the order at full price; GET /api/push/config returns enabled=true with a valid VAPID public_key (~87 chars), /api/push/subscribe upserts and /api/push/unsubscribe deletes, /api/push/test with no active subscription returns a friendly 400 ('No active device found. Turn alerts on for this device first.'); PUT /api/users/me with city='Berlin' auto-updates country_code to 'DE'; /api/discover?country=United%20Kingdom returns London members. Frontend browser flows: /events country dropdown (data-testid=events-country) filters cards correctly at 1920x1080 and at 390x844 mobile; currency selector in the navbar switches ₹ → £ → ¥ across /events and /passes and persists across reload (localStorage), JPY renders with no decimals; home hero + footer say '27 cities · 12 countries' and 'a global social club · 27 cities, 12 countries'; /safety lists 112 (EU), 911 (US/CA), 999 (UK/UAE/SG), 000 (AU); /events 'Past & rated' shows both finished events with the highlighted quote block (data-testid=event-quote-<id>) — 4.67 stars, reviewer first names TARA and KUNAL, italic quotes; /register?ref=TARAJO03DC shows the referral-banner ('Tara invited you to Buddilio · ₹250 credit'); reg-country + reg-city selects present on step 2; /profile has profile-country, profile-city and push-toggle-btn (Push subscription itself is blocked by Playwright's default incognito-like context — Chrome disables the Push API in incognito, so we verified only the UI state + backend contract). Two CRITICAL runtime crashes were found and fixed inside this run.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: Gift is not defined — missing lucide-react icon import. Whole /dashboard route crashed for every logged-in user, so dash-referral-card (and every other dashboard tile) was unreachable.

ReferenceError: fmt is not defined — fmt() is used inside the referral banner JSX but useCurrency() was never imported/called. Every visit to /register?ref=<CODE> crashed to an error overlay, so no new user could sign up via a referral link.

issues: A React hydration warning ('In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>') is logged because dev tooling injects an x-excluded <span> inside every <option>. This is a Vite/emergent instrumentation artifact and does not affect users, but it fires on every page load — worth silencing in the dev overlay if possible.

action_items: Both critical crashes have already been patched by me — Dashboard.jsx now imports Gift from lucide-react and Auth.jsx now imports/uses useCurrency() so fmt() resolves. Please review the diffs and keep them; a fresh yarn build should ship them.
Consider adding an ESLint 'no-undef' or a Vite build-time check in CI so a missing icon/hook import can never ship again — both bugs are pure typos that a lint step would catch.

Push subscription cannot be exercised in headless Playwright (Chrome refuses the Push API under incognito). Add a small backend-only integration smoke that POSTs a fake subscription and calls /push/test with a mocked pywebpush send, so we do not rely on browser push in CI.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~2333 lines and now hosts globalization, referrals, push, checkout, moderation, payments, chat and admin — splitting into feature routers (checkout/referrals/push/global) is overdue.

The /api/events?country=… and /api/discover?country=… parameters filter by the human-readable country NAME (e.g. 'United Arab Emirates'), not the ISO code. The frontend selects pass the name and this works, but any external integrator will assume ISO codes; consider accepting both (name OR code) in one param or renaming to country_name for clarity.

credit_balance() is O(N) — sums every credit row for the user on every /me/referrals, every /checkout, and every fulfil_order. On a heavier user this will become a hot path; keep a users.credit_balance denormalised field or an aggregate.

In checkout(), credit is applied unconditionally when total>1 and use_credit is true. Consider a max_credit cap per order and a hard 'refund credit if payment fails' step (currently credit is only debited AT fulfilment, which is correct, but the current order document still records credit_applied on a pending order — clarify in the UI so users are not confused if they cancel).

push.py falls back gracefully on 404/410 endpoints, but repeated /push/test with the same tag will overwrite the previous notification on some browsers — that is a UX choice, but worth documenting in the code so it is not read as a bug.

IMPORTANT gotchas that ate time: (1) /api/events?country=… wants the NAME 'United Arab Emirates', NOT 'AE'. (2) /api/auth/register requires `mobile` (bare RegisterIn field) and stores `email` lowercased. (3) Profile update endpoint is PUT /api/users/me, not /api/me. (4) /api/meta returns currencies as a LIST of dicts `[{code:'INR',…}]`, not a dict keyed by code. (5) Referral test invitees end up as `test_ref_*` (lowercased) in Mongo — search with regex '$options':'i'. (6) Playwright cannot exercise real Push in headless Chromium — assert the UI states + backend contract instead. Existing pytest suites: backend_test.py, test_iteration2.py, test_iteration3.py, test_iteration4.py, test_iteration5.py — all currently green.
rca of the issue: Two crashes were introduced by the same class of mistake: a symbol was used inside JSX without importing it. Dashboard.jsx uses `<Gift/>` inside dash-referral-card but only imports Compass/Ticket/MessageCircle/Bell/Heart/CalendarDays/Star from lucide-react. Auth.jsx's Register component uses `{fmt(inviter.reward)}` inside the referral banner but never destructures fmt from useCurrency (and CurrencyContext was not even imported). Both routes render at first paint before hydration finishes, so users see the standard CRA overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors' and no functional recovery. Fix: two one-line imports and one destructure. Verified by re-rendering /dashboard and /register?ref=TARAJO03DC — no console errors, dash-referral-card links to /referrals, referral-banner reads 'Tara invited you to Buddilio · ₹250 credit'.
